reason: User requested proper completion of unfinished spring-product retrospective coverage.

findings.root_cause: Existing policy only allowed a tiny retrospective batch after daily/gap work, while other candidate pools were later summarized as if they were canonical spring coverage.

corrective_actions: Make spring backfill an independent track that is not blocked by unresolved daily observation gaps.
Use approved KC40 scope, deep-dive brands first, then monitoring brands.
Track January through June separately; May-June are early-summer context and not merged with spring-core without labeling.
Require month-level official evidence before assigning a product to a month.
Keep access-limited and offline-unverified cells incomplete.
Never use candidate-pool or generic retrospective counts as the canonical spring-backfill count.
